channel.title: Pier & Point · 500 Terry A. Francois Boulevard
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for 500 Terry A. Francois Boulevard (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · 500 Terry A. Francois Boulevard: 500 Terry A. Francois Boulevard: the contractor's…
item.description: 500 Terry A. Francois Boulevard: the contractor's project page lists ML Mission Bay LLC as owner, Gordon Chong Partners as architect and Swinerton Builders as general contractor, with a 2008 completion year. Cisco's office list gives the address but no date, and no source read dates Cisco's or Meraki's occupancy. Source: Clark Pacific project page (clarkpacific.com/project/500-terry-francois-mission-bay-block-26a/); Cisco office locations (cisco.com/site/us/en/about/contact-cisco/office-locations.html).

item.title: Correction · 500 Terry A. Francois Boulevard: The 500 Terry A. Francois page no longer shows the…

item.title: Correction · 500 Terry A. Francois Boulevard: The map notes said tenants have included Cisco and Wix
item.description: The map notes said tenants have included Cisco and Wix. The cited Clark Pacific, SF Chronicle and OpenStreetMap pages support Cisco (through its Meraki division) but never mention Wix, so a dated correction withdrawing Wix was added to the map notes. The Wikimedia aerial's credit now names only the Commons username Firstcultural, as the file page does. Source: San Francisco Chronicle, 2023 (https://www.sfchronicle.com/tech/article/tech-giant-signs-s-f-s-biggest-office-lease-17878648.php); Clark Pacific, 500 Terry Francois (https://www.clarkpacific.com/project/500-terry-francois-mission-bay-block-26a/) (does not state this); OpenStreetMap way 28844040 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/28844040) (does not state this); Wikimedia Commons file page (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aerial_photo_of_San_Francisco%27s_Mission_Bay,_ballpark,_and_Caltrain_area.jpg).

item.title: Milestone · 500 Terry A. Francois Boulevard: SF Dept. of Building Inspection permit… (May 3, 2007)
item.description: SF Dept. of Building Inspection permit #200705030366 filed (the application date) for a temporary tower crane "for construction of 6 story building" at this address; DBI approved it on 2007-09-11 and issued it on 2007-09-20. A crane permit is not a construction start, and no source read dates the start of construction (May 3, 2007). Source: DataSF / SF Department of Building Inspection.
